senses.sense_definition: Used to acknowledge a clever remark, a good point, or a successful comeback made by an opponent in an argument or discussion.

examples.text: When she pointed out his mistake with a witty remark, he just laughed and said, “<w>Touché</w>.”
“You can hardly criticize my cooking after burning the toast this morning.” “<w>Touché</w>, fair point.”

senses.sense_definition: Used in fencing by a competitor to acknowledge that their opponent has successfully landed a hit.

examples.text: The fencer lowered his foil and called out “<w>touché</w>” after receiving a direct blow to the chest.
Before the referee could even call the point, she acknowledged the strike with a clear “<w>touché</w>.”
